assignments.task: Propose an as-is domain and context baseline: interview speaker, interviewer, microphone, browser and environmental noise. Distinguish application scope from the auxiliary VS Code extension and identify missing stakeholder and usage evidence.

Capture documented concise-answer intent and current timing-feedback scope separately from planned speaker identification, transcription and semantic coaching. Flag unresolved timing targets without choosing or approving them.

Model current start-listening, microphone permission success/failure, manual signal and automatic turn-reset flows. Capture automatic override of manual choices and the absence of speaker identity discrimination.

Inventory available validation evidence and gaps for speech detection, short pauses, silence reset, timing boundaries, background noise and permission failures. Treat 'Already proven' as a documented claim; propose verification criteria separately without executing tests or inventing results.

Capture the implemented browser audio-to-display architecture and the configured Azure Static Web Apps delivery topology. Distinguish local audio processing from hosting and development tooling; do not infer that the workflow deployed successfully.

Extract actual constants, state and timing rules from app.js, including strict >25/>35-second transitions, RMS >0.02, 300 ms speaking hold, >2500 ms silence reset and 100 ms polling. Contrast these with HLD claims and capture microphone resource lifecycle and manual-control behavior without changing code.

Inventory existing visual-and-notes documentation units, record threshold contradictions and identify missing review, approval and release evidence. Propose documentation reconciliation for human review without rewriting artifacts or claiming release completion.
